assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

baseline_excerpt: Choose assignments, prepare, complete objectives and build a dependable reputation. Compare risk, pay and time, then choose worthwhile work. A future adventurer's guild can support the same loop.
assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

baseline_excerpt: Put growing capabilities to use and let success feel impressive. Seek worthwhile training and dramatic challenges, outgrow familiar obstacles and earn recognition through feats people actually witness.
assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

baseline_excerpt: Demanding opposition and lasting, proportionate consequences. Scout, prepare, manage real resources and choose risks. Retreat, negotiation and careful planning can be as valuable as winning a fight.
assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.

baseline_excerpt: Optional solo challenge: one life, no ordinary knockout return. The same world and normal enemy scaling, with final consequences for a genuine lethal defeat. Recommended for experienced players.
assignment: Review available activities and emphasis; preserve continuity and numerical settings.
